tier_1_local_fast.name: Print House HK (default)
tier_1_local_fast.use_when: Urgent runs, small batches, samples, first-time designs, quality testing
tier_1_local_fast.risk: lowest — established relationship, confirmed quality, no MOQ

tier_2_alibaba_full_garment.name: Alibaba Full Garment (cost play)
tier_2_alibaba_full_garment.use_when: Planned runs with 3+ week lead time, proven designs, bulk 60-100+
tier_2_alibaba_full_garment.lead_time: 2-5 days production + 2-5 days SF Express to HK
tier_2_alibaba_full_garment.shipping: HK$100-300 for 60 pcs via SF Express
tier_2_alibaba_full_garment.risk: medium — use Trade Assurance, order samples first
action_needed: Order 1-2 sample tees via Alibaba Trade Assurance
Compare quality side-by-side with Print House
Confirm DTF on 100% cotton, A3 back print capability
Establish 1 trusted Alibaba supplier before bulk

tier_3_dtf_transfers_inhouse.name: DTF Transfers + Heat Press (cheat code)
tier_3_dtf_transfers_inhouse.use_when: Ongoing regular runs, maximum margin, full control over timing
tier_3_dtf_transfers_inhouse.how_it_works: Order printed DTF transfer sheets from China. Buy blank 100% cotton tees locally or wholesale. Heat press in-house at gym/storage.
tier_3_dtf_transfers_inhouse.heat_press_investment: HK$1,500-3,000 one-time (pays for itself in 1 run of 60)
tier_3_dtf_transfers_inhouse.risk: low-medium — requires learning heat press technique, storage space
action_needed: Research heat press models (A3+ platen for poster tees)
Practice on cheap blank tees before production
Find blank tee wholesale supplier in HK (Sham Shui Po?)
tier_3_dtf_transfers_inhouse.note: This is the long-term play. Print House stays for samples/testing. Transfers for proven designs at scale.

tier_4_india_freight_bundle.name: India (piggyback on glove imports)
tier_4_india_freight_bundle.use_when: Combining with existing India glove shipments, larger planned batches
tier_4_india_freight_bundle.shipping: Bundle with glove freight — marginal cost
tier_4_india_freight_bundle.risk: medium — new relationship needed, but same freight route as gloves
action_needed: Ask glove supplier: 'Do you know garment printers in Tiruppur? We need DTF on 100% cotton.'
If yes, request sample + quote for 60 pcs poster tee
tier_4_india_freight_bundle.note: Tiruppur is India's t-shirt capital. Same freight route as gloves = near-zero incremental shipping.
